I’ve been criss-crossing the country campaigning with some A-tier Conservatives. Check out these 5 photos!
| Your continued support for the MAGA Movement has not gone unnoticed, and for that, thank you.
I understand that you're probably getting bombarded with emails and texts trying to trick you into donating, pretending to be President Trump, offering fake memberships, or claiming your donation will be matched 50X. Georgians have gotten used to being told what is impossible.
We’ve gotten better at proving the doubters wrong.
For decades, conventional wisdom held that a Democrat could not come close to winning the governor’s office, that a legislature drawn by politicians who rigged the maps to keep control could not change, that Georgia wouldn’t vote blue in a presidential election.
Yet, between 2014 and 2020, Democrats added 800,000 Georgians to the process and proved otherwise. In 2018, we flipped 11 State House seats. In 2020, Georgia elected Jon Ossoff and Raphael Warnock.
And we’ve won more legislative seats in every election since then, putting us in a strong position to finally take control of the chamber.
And take it from someone who’s served as Minority Leader in the Georgia State House: laws passed in the State House affect daily life in Georgia — determining if families can afford to pay the rent or mortgage, see a doctor, and send their kids to schools with enough teachers and books.
If we all do our part in this final sprint to Election Day, Georgia families will have a State House focused on lowering costs, expanding opportunity, and protecting our freedoms — not politicians who use power to help themselves.

Scroll down to read her email. = Together, we can support Democracy Champions, prevent voter suppression, and make sure people have the information they need to make their voices heard at the ballot box. In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team | | = = \------------------Forwarded Message------------------ From: Stacey Abrams Subject: This is how we take the Georgia State House from red to blue Stacey Abrams Introduces: “GA Takes the House” Fair Fight has a plan to pick up the 10 seats Democrats need to win control of the Georgia State House — but it’s going to take strong grassroots support. = The math is clear: For the first time since 2004, Georgia Democrats have a chance to take a state legislative chamber. We only need to pick up 10 seats to win control of the State House — not as many as we gained in 2018. But it will take work: supporting House candidates, volunteering, making a voting plan, and making sure friends and family are registered and ready to vote. In 2019, Fair Fight was created to do this work: door by door, seat by seat, cycle by cycle. We have watched Georgia trend blue because people keep showing up and engaging, even after the votes are counted. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Georgians have gotten used to being told what is impossible. We’ve gotten better at proving the doubters wrong. For decades, conventional wisdom held that a Democrat could not come close to winning the governor’s office, that a legislature drawn by politicians who rigged the maps to keep control could not change, that Georgia wouldn’t vote blue in a presidential election. Yet, between 2014 and 2020, Democrats added 800,000 Georgians to the process and proved otherwise. In 2018, we flipped 11 State House seats. In 2020, Georgia elected Jon Ossoff and Raphael Warnock. And we’ve won more legislative seats in every election since then, putting us in a strong position to finally take control of the chamber. And take it from someone who’s served as Minority Leader in the Georgia State House: laws passed in the State House affect daily life in Georgia — determining if families can afford to pay the rent or mortgage, see a doctor, and send their kids to schools with enough teachers and books. clean_body: The threats keep coming, and we won't stop fighting| | | | | | All of the progress that has come the last few decades -- widespread use of mail-in ballots, early voting, weekend voting, expanded hours to vote, the ability to vote at a precinct closer to your work than your home, safe and secure drop boxes \-- they're all on the chopping block with opponents of voting rights. Mail-in ballots are just the latest domino they want to knock over in a long chain that ends when they suppress the people they think vote against them and get to stay in power for perpetuity. = | | | | Team , opponents of voting rights from the president on down claim mail-in voting makes our elections less secure and vulnerable to fraud.But research proves that’s not the case. Instances of mail-in voting fraud are vanishingly rare, and over 58% of Americans are in favor of allowing ANY voter to cast their ballot by mail.And to make matters worse, this new Executive Order, which the Supreme Court has temporarily rubber-stamped, would place the U.S. Postal Service, letter carriers, and election officials at risk of prosecution, putting the burden of proving mail-in voter eligibility on the post office to get around the U.S. Constitution. Team, we must take action now to protect mail-in voting ahead of November's midterms , or millions of Americans could find themselves unable to cast a ballot.= | | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | | = | | = | | | We need as many Americans as possible to show the Supreme Court, the President, and the vote suppressors nationwide that we will not stand for this un-American attack on our democracy. We must not allow our election policies to be driven by misinformation, Team. The fate of our democracy depends on making every eligible vote count and every voice heard. Our fundamental right to vote has to be protected at all costs.= | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. = = Contributions or gifts to Integrity First Voter Action Project are not tax-deductible as charitable contributions or as business expenses under IRC Section 162(3). Here’s a quick wrap up about what we’ve been up to in the other Washington and here at home. _**In June, I was focused on safety and privacy for Washington families:**_ We pressed the administration in advance of fire season over the closure of _57 of 77_ Forest Service research labs —**including two in Washington state.** These labs do important work that helps keep our neighbors safe during wildfires and other significant weather events. I’m not going to mince words when it comes to the folks who continue to push our safety concerns aside to line the pockets of the billionaires that have bought them out. **This fight is just getting started.** I also introduced a bill alongside Reps. Casar and Holmes Norton that protects FAFSA applicants’ privacy. **This bill would prohibit DHS and other federal agencies from accessing personal identifying information found on the FAFSA application.** We know that ICE is not operating in good faith, and it’s so important to me that young people pursuing higher education don’t have to choose between affordable education and their own safety. _**In July, we celebrated the people and natural beauty of Washington’s 6th Congressional District:**_ We celebrated community wins like the reopening of the T**heler Wetlands Nature Center in Belfair,** an incredible resource that gives families a place to explore and connect with the natural beauty of our region. On the final day of the month, I was honored beyond words to join the people of the Quinault Indian Nation for the final stretch of the Canoe Journey. This year, tribes from across the Pacific Northwest paddled to the Nisqually Medicine Creek Potlatch, where they spent several days in celebration and togetherness. I learned so much from my Quinault neighbors as we pulled to the end and was inspired by their relentless commitment to caring for and preserving the Salish Sea for the next seven generations. _**In August, we won our primary,[and we’re ready to win the general and flip the House in November:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138167847/643283927/-1265565946?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2026.08.29_EoSRecap&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDBmYzY0Yy0xM2E0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=F7OyejCy-vefBNDDkU6UyCK8VPeY1K6I5fCWfaBmFdM=)**_ Thanks to all the hard work my team has been doing to make sure my neighbors are heard, seen, and ready to vote – **we won our primary election with 58.8% of the vote despite having FOUR opponents.** The race isn’t over yet, and we’ve got so many other folks to get elected. clean_body: | Hey, Peter! The end of summer is just around the corner, and it’s been a good one. = Obviously there’s a ton going on — both good and bad. Here’s a quick wrap up about what we’ve been up to in the other Washington and here at home. In June, I was focused on safety and privacy for Washington families: We pressed the administration in advance of fire season over the closure of 57 of 77 Forest Service research labs —including two in Washington state. These labs do important work that helps keep our neighbors safe during wildfires and other significant weather events. I’m not going to mince words when it comes to the folks who continue to push our safety concerns aside to line the pockets of the billionaires that have bought them out. This fight is just getting started. I also introduced a bill alongside Reps. Casar and Holmes Norton that protects FAFSA applicants’ privacy. This bill would prohibit DHS and other federal agencies from accessing personal identifying information found on the FAFSA application. We know that ICE is not operating in good faith, and it’s so important to me that young people pursuing higher education don’t have to choose between affordable education and their own safety. In July, we celebrated the people and natural beauty of Washington’s 6th Congressional District: We celebrated community wins like the reopening of the Theler Wetlands Nature Center in Belfair, an incredible resource that gives families a place to explore and connect with the natural beauty of our region. On the final day of the month, I was honored beyond words to join the people of the Quinault Indian Nation for the final stretch of the Canoe Journey. This year, tribes from across the Pacific Northwest paddled to the Nisqually Medicine Creek Potlatch, where they spent several days in celebration and togetherness. I learned so much from my Quinault neighbors as we pulled to the end and was inspired by their relentless commitment to caring for and preserving the Salish Sea for the next seven generations. In August, we won our primary,= Thanks to all the hard work my team has been doing to make sure my neighbors are heard, seen, and ready to vote – we won our primary election with 58.8% of the vote despite having FOUR opponents. The race isn’t over yet, and we’ve got so many other folks to get elected. subject: Gina’s vision vs. Abbott’s record
body:
Abbott has a track record of selling Texans out.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Gina’s vision for Texas**
✅ Strengthen public schools so every child in Texas has a good quality education, and ensure public school teachers are among the highest paid in the nation.
✅ Lower living costs and help working families keep more of their hard-earned money.
✅ Protect our water and power grid by putting real guardrails on unchecked data centers.
✅ Hold health insurance companies accountable and ensure Texans have access to quality healthcare.
**Abbott’s record**
❌ Took $1M+ from corporate mega-donors like Kelcy Warren, who profits off fueling massive data centers.
❌ Starved public education, forcing over 170 Texas schools to close their doors.
❌ Ignored the affordability crisis, leaving **billions** in federal taxpayer relief on the table.
❌ Offered a weak, temporary pause on data centers instead of real accountability.
Peter, it's clear that Abbott hasn’t been working for Texans; he’s been selling us out to the people with the deepest pockets. And he’s got to go.

body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Hello!
We had hoped to reach out sooner, but in the days after the election we quickly returned to work. That urgency delayed this note, and we wanted to take a moment to thank you for standing with us.
Election night didn’t go the way we wanted. The candidate selected by the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) earned more votes than the six grassroots candidates _combined_. NBC projected Shannon Taylor as the winner 40 minutes after polls closed. Congratulations, Shannon. We are eager to see her fire Rob Wittman.
While one chapter has come to a close, the story is far from over. The work continues, and we invite you to follow the next chapter by subscribing to my [SubStack](https://erickakopp.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be2b03077b3c4d3385f5eaa6f&id=cae64ead10&e=1030105c7f) and following along on [Threads](https://us.list-manage.com/18T6iMTsPLC?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) for updates on my latest efforts. To all of the wonderful people in Virginia’s first district, to our volunteers, donors, and supporters, we THANK YOU for all the ways in which you’ve helped with this campaign!
Will there be another campaign? I don’t know yet. For now, I am grateful. Thank you for believing in me. Thank you for believing in more. More for yourselves and your neighbors, for our nation, and for the next generation. It’s my honor to continue to fight alongside you.
Onward and upward!
Ericka Kopp and Team EK4VA

Moments ago, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states.

|
Peter,
Earlier this week, the US Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with its effort to ban mail-in ballots in blue states.
For some context, earlier this Summer Trump called on dozens of blue states across the country to share their voter data with the administration. When they declined Trump initiated a process to have the USPS revoke their ability to use mail-in ballots.
For months, lower courts held the line preventing Trump from carrying out the order. Today that changed. Trump is now on the cusp of making true on his threat to blue states that if they do not hand over sensitive voter data they can't use mail-in ballots.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001clnrspfYTfhvfpXnJj5Ndj8mo4JjwV9aIqvBjth8r4Ht0_5mWP-GjmI681jC5-XCQWJm5q-6Nui_Yl3yaoTszc0ShPKeUvSWrJ2G00pBx2TnR72kB5OVvoTvwofboDVryNBpyykMsSwrbU19s_sja-J_KgCrWUiFU_k7vgDpP-7ScH2HL-Jec5eyH0hsShiCjBfCpkTgT1VAXVtt8uAvmTY3ZJjJ7FKdcDPaK3DjCnvn3IsN5wu5iM8FaV3bb9gD&c=080EtL4lzvWRwZq4dE9Ggid5RUtpjKCTuclr2K2D_1zRndleD4o9TQ==&ch=8RY7Im_4aREQGAmWka3m1dzkQP6mNeHASMm06skNDGl8oS5LikFvIg==)

Blue states are rightfully declining to share their voter list with the White House because sharing them would give MAGA the names and addresses of every Democratic voter.
The reasons why MAGA wants these names and addresses are two fold:
In the short term it will help MAGA rig elections by knowing exactly whose ballots to challenge and throw out. But the long term is far more disturbing. It lets the administration and aligned far-right paramilitary groups know where every Democrat lives.
No governor in their right mind would go along with handing over that data so what this means is that blue state voters will soon no longer have the right to vote by mail.
Challenges to this rule will continue to ping-pong between federal courts, but ultimately this fight will land back in the Supreme Court where they will issue their final decision. And let's not fool ourselves, we know exactly how this court packed with right-wing extremists will rule.
This is why Defend Our Courts mission is now more important than ever. We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
This is it. The nightmare scenario is now a reality. [We need to make this election too big to rig and save our Democracy. The remainder came from dividends, interest, retirement distributions, and other sources. Seven-figure incomes are least common in West Virginia, where 0.16% of tax filers met the threshold. **Whatever happened to S &H Green Stamps?** For decades, S&H Green Stamps were as much a part of the American grocery run as the groceries themselves. Then, almost overnight, they weren't. The Sperry & Hutchinson Company launched its trading stamps in 1896, giving shoppers one stamp for every 10 cents spent at participating stores. Customers licked the gummed backs, pasted them into free booklets, and redeemed filled books for merchandise at local showrooms. The concept took off during the Depression, and by the 1960s, more than 60% of American consumers were [saving the little green squares](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUj2P6zgM_DVKl4CmbH0ULnZhBNhirzrgSkOW6EQXxTIkJUbu1x_kLF77iteRHnJmPOI_3-O38cEvl7_Mnfoyx3GhLQcqhdL4pIX-e1AwcaUlRx9mT8HlmUYEFEdQRw6jscU_aWzNwfUzERI_UN9IpUC1XOnDtdfOTEI4IbsZpe20IScAWjV1jaNJ8YPvKx8oDg2AQHmCtpvlLOZmdlZLEqwFcr7EdPo3-qVcaQ6v-KR0svF-CP21lDUz_sHwzPC8bduJJvOqIMNztleGZ3-6lntg_Dwut43xITP8ZNihuDL8vCSiheFnLua-ZoZiianSMz40DMX9Rs_yq07eMT7IpjnyFgCODQepjrBjdsdwr_O7aaC2N3ptMbnfCtsUVsaHEaHRIEExFN9_j18D4wNDcaE47qQMRQrZFJMuVJ3dNneUQmjQGnXXSgUMO_4Roj02ulozbo35vejo6S0xPtjdZnmt9AZCtIwPWiiuGYo1-vdnM9mvH017Xy8L40N9J9WBrMzZFwrL7WfWXVJ8rO8fR5TQdcCFAgkoaqxUtpjqbKzaptjrjzzVPttw21cno0kr206ia5tGCeygm7FrcdJGN3MN9BHGJZq1hlXSgw6pd-vmQ_BZSNbC5W582K-j_OFRP3v8PwAA__-YRfXQ). S&H boasted it printed three times as many stamps as the U.S. Postal Service, and its rewards catalog became the largest single publication in the country.

Families would spread that catalog across the kitchen table, [flipping through pages of toasters, luggage sets, bicycles, and transistor radios](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu7CAUAE-DO1YYvIALit-429-mtB7mYb8Eg2WIV8npo80VUo80I83bY34AJcrrf9jRtVjmjM-asDU85wszfn9ignJgroVSJEyhRpylkJoLy5WYYWl04TxAF1xElKg6dL2xVthB2bHbHAgA6VXwxureCu-9X3CBGNUYtbqbjtzLJ6wSvRBampsY7tFEHfsYltGgZoPAQK2ct_dCuW0Y01e58LwtZe-S21o7KlP_mJyYnGKCunn4eEEmp0QXZd425OFE2PmT2sbXEzHz2mA_Kgfej-bOF2iQysql7q1hcupOF44npURVGzaIdQdKv8X2x1GXkz8BAAD__6q0fjE), counting up filled books and debating what to save for next. Andy Warhol even turned the stamps into Pop Art in 1962. Competitors piled in. Gold Bond, Top Value, Plaid, and Blue Chip Stamps all chased the same kitchen-table loyalty. But the end came for all of them beginning in the 1970s. The oil embargo gutted the gas station channel. Double-digit inflation made the stamps feel like a hidden surcharge, spurring discount chains like Kmart to promise everyday low prices instead of deferred rewards. By the late 1980s, fewer than 100 retailers still offered Green Stamps. S&H tried going digital with an online "Greenpoints" program, but that too, quietly shut down in October 2020. You can see the program's current direction at [MyGreenStamps.com](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykj7FuwyAYBp_G3hL9BhvIwNAlW7p2RNR8f0yFwTLUUfr0VfoK3e9Ouo-bu_mYYr6_-xW2cXEZj5rQGnZ3IOPnG8mXDbmWmDgihcpwgoQ6kTlJcn5u8YAbfR8sAwKyhx20MWRGaS79YjExDVMYWGIEmzCESXzOijFLzfChj_bVIyNpIFJCn2mcWLPigcN80VDdSAixlf38VWJuCzg9y4H9PJe1T3ZpbaudfOvEtRPX9XnfgVybX7f6Ijpx7XcbtkdMKValu5Huq4_pz27_nD6s-A0AAP__e7ZtpQ) Green Stamps no longer exist, but today your grocery store loyalty card, your frequent-flyer miles, and your credit card points all trace their DNA straight back to those sticky little stamps. _Did your family collect S &H Green Stamps or another brand? For decades, S&H Green Stamps were as much a part of the American grocery run as the groceries themselves. Then, almost overnight, they weren't. The Sperry & Hutchinson Company launched its trading stamps in 1896, giving shoppers one stamp for every 10 cents spent at participating stores. Customers licked the gummed backs, pasted them into free booklets, and redeemed filled books for merchandise at local showrooms. The concept took off during the Depression, and by the 1960s, more than 60% of American consumers were . S&H boasted it printed three times as many stamps as the U.S. Postal Service, and its rewards catalog became the largest single publication in the country. Families would spread that catalog across the kitchen table, , counting up filled books and debating what to save for next. Andy Warhol even turned the stamps into Pop Art in 1962. Competitors piled in. Gold Bond, Top Value, Plaid, and Blue Chip Stamps all chased the same kitchen-table loyalty. But the end came for all of them beginning in the 1970s. The oil embargo gutted the gas station channel. Double-digit inflation made the stamps feel like a hidden surcharge, spurring discount chains like Kmart to promise everyday low prices instead of deferred rewards. By the late 1980s, fewer than 100 retailers still offered Green Stamps. S&H tried going digital with an online "Greenpoints" program, but that too, quietly shut down in October 2020. You can see the program's current direction at Green Stamps no longer exist, but today your grocery store loyalty card, your frequent-flyer miles, and your credit card points all trace their DNA straight back to those sticky little stamps. _**It feels like I typed and re-typed this note close to 100 times before I knew just how I wanted to say this. **_

**Not because I questioned my message, but because of just how critical it is that this message be received clearly. **

**Truthfully, this is more personal and from the heart than most messages, because it's going to patriots that I feel I can trust as our movement’s closest confidants.**

Every time I stand behind the resolute desk, or walk into a critical cabinet meeting to make a decision surrounded by the most dedicated and fearless men and women in our country, I feel the very weight of our country’s survival in my hands and the responsibility of what it represents — a thin, fragile line between the America we love and the America the radical left is determined to build in its place.

_And when I sit alone with my thoughts and my prayers the question I ask myself constantly is**“what more can I do?” **_

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

clean_body: Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. | Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have nominated buy this seat. Thank you for standing with me, Darline Graham United States Senator P.S. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who 's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I 'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I 'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. | I put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. I 'm committing my blood, sweat, and tears to take this seat back from the political class. I 'd be honored if you'd be willing to stand alongside me. Any type of donations will make a impact on our path to victory. I hope you 'll join us, but either way, God bless you! Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele TafoyaRepublican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise.

**[But I need you with me, starting today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=644f35aceae049e7a4a879dc52ea6549&_e=DOEXJ3MymYJmgaA4KqkrI-g013qdQ_6PdhwT9MbuT7a1y-yZI-KnDRqvdIwb8Mf-ZFR8WB7lomomFATk9WfHGM39uWNf4ilZ0ll5BKSuw7gFl2wecpA3fxoKtkXnvFM_gQh6gj4Su03o6vJJaKX7OSLVKdh20osu0eloScp5-QH9s-YNGmnOcc1xfTj8_h2eJPOrmZBB1DnmG_RE5NPs8Ps0Rg63sNH2omiY8S8gdjt-4Gc7-6KWBRLMNzD1Rd1z5cS_3cgdQRELiMBJUUBxaeFQLqhPMEH2xkNdBIXgzcCwC8FSOVSDRJHSFkf1WANCbqlObyU-xF-NRYIai5o7lWqEt33K7L3EjExMWm2kN9OmLGu7hPp9lilrZJA2FzFS2vsXd6eui1KOziAoG_UMSWe4yjxTf6aG2eUZxM6H5BjvRum6LUBFneJtWrAd3u6esxDUSGN0GtNW5LWFMHx2dcmq9Lmq3DCAE2bowkXhCyPqtdwUuLszYmrTCfd6bYRzU3lDtvmR1MGCzdYSlzL3LR2R6B31Y6c8N9xk8cUm8c2eeWEl6P_Eks3bqpcciTZp8qHSBDBljP67LwVv5dBAd7MvHWENlPKzHfHBQxisEVpJHPvQIEIshE4kUIMY9CR2XPzEAmoy_H9wTVAYQqHcdeTprsox7X3uxYK7YtKp2imm5svfFnJL39mldA_p9OyJjKPCgkPo_P1p2hWOEGHJf59LZa4P9dnTi4dnrWoLrvM%3D)**

clean_body: The special and the runoff took everything we had. November is less than 70 days away. | Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have nominated buy this seat. Thank you for standing with me, Darline Graham United States Senator P.S. Every donor, whether it's your first donation or you've been with us since day one, tells the Hollywood donors watching this race that South Carolina is still behind us after two hard-fought elections. | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. name: Alex Vindman
subject: Humbly asking…
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
... for my brother

Peter –
First and foremost, I want to thank you for all of your support over the years. You had my back after the threats from Trump and MAGA Republicans when I blew the whistle on his not-so-perfect phone call with Ukraine – the one that led to his first impeachment.
Those were tough times for me and my family, and you were there for us.
I also want to thank you for your support during my campaign for Senate. While the race did not end the way I had hoped, please know that I will be doing everything I can to help elect Democrats everywhere this November.
And while I wish I did not have to ask again, I do. This time, not for me – but for my brother, Congressman Eugene Vindman: A man of courage, honor and integrity who is running for re-election in a tough race.
Eugene won one of the closest races in the country last cycle, and that makes him a big time target for Republicans who want to keep control of the House, and a president who'd love to defeat the second Vindman twin.
Eugene has a big end-of-month fundraising deadline coming up. And when it ends, he's got some difficult budget decisions to make about the rest of the campaign and what it takes to win.
He tells me that he's a bit short of where he needs to be right now, so I wanted to help.
So please:
[**If re-taking the House and re-electing a man of integrity to the chamber means something to you, then I am humbly asking you to make a $25 donation to my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia before his end-of-month fundraising deadline comes to a close. subject: Zombie Mines 🧟
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Let's talk about Zombie Mines.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=65%2E42639%2ExPaGeT)
Let's talk about Zombie Mines.
These are mines that corporations have abandoned all over the country, with many of them in Pennsylvania.
What happens is mining companies walk away from these mines and they pollute our streams, our waterways, and our soil.
It probably won't surprise you to hear that some of these companies exploit loopholes in our law to keep these mines technically active so they do not have to pay the cost of cleanup. Others may declare bankruptcy to restructure their assets and avoid doing the environmental work necessary to protect our communities.
And who pays that multi-billion tab for reclamation when these companies find a loophole to avoid their responsibilities?
You do. We all do.
I introduced a bill with Congresswoman Lee to end these practices.
**[Please watch a very short video I created on Zombie Mines. And while you are there, please like and subscribe to my channel.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/384?t=2&akid=65%2E42639%2ExPaGeT)**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Regular readers know that I have written quite a bit about AI and the breathtaking speed at which it has grown. Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, [described the trajectory](https://substack.com/redirect/8f4c3bf4-a665-4907-a182-4ce1f5361b60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as heading toward "a country of geniuses in a datacenter." It sure feels like the future will be filled with machines that can already outthink most humans in most domains. But it's not just intellectually where the machines are surpassing us. It's physically too.
Being outperformed by a machine is nothing new. After all, cars and tractors and factories full of equipment have been doing so for centuries. But the development of humanoid robots, machines built to resemble humans that walk on two legs with two moving arms, has been advancing at accelerating rate. Further, the humanoids are increasingly becoming _autonomous_.
All of this was on full display during the recent [World Humanoid Robot Games](https://substack.com/redirect/afa2ad02-b94b-4dc2-b5c8-fba0f04384a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Beijing. Held at the National Speed Skating Oval, the very venue the PRC built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the competition brought together [over 2,000 humanoid robots from 666 teams across 16 countries](https://substack.com/redirect/afa2ad02-b94b-4dc2-b5c8-fba0f04384a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The robots competed in 51 events, from sprinting to soccer and table tennis to kickboxing. **[More than 40% of the events required fully autonomous operation](https://substack.com/redirect/afa2ad02-b94b-4dc2-b5c8-fba0f04384a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. And by fully autonomous, I mean that there were no human operators with joysticks, remote controls, or intervention of any kind. These robots operated on their own.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5d803e0f-1f9f-439d-9b32-f55b5d308197?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Some of the achievements were staggering. China's Tiangong Ultra clocked [9.39 seconds in the 100-meter dash](https://substack.com/redirect/afa2ad02-b94b-4dc2-b5c8-fba0f04384a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); faster than Usain Bolt's human world record of 9.58. Another robot ran 400 meters in 39.7 seconds. The pace of improvement is stunning. The fastest 100-meter time at [last year's inaugural Games](https://substack.com/redirect/69948f5d-4d31-4048-af7a-2c3b46a3a51f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was 21.5 seconds. In a mere twelve months, the robots shaved more than 12 seconds off the sprint, a **56% improvement**. Human improvement in the 100-meter event has been measured in hundredths of a second per decade. Robots improved by twelve seconds in a year.
Even as robot improvements are accelerating, there are clearly still some challenges to replacing humans. They're not perfect (yet). Just for fun, you might enjoy watching this video with some of the biggest "fails" from the Beijing event:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c91e77e5-64fe-47d4-b972-d9a50806c93c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Of course, there's a geopolitical angle to the humanoids as well. This event was designed to showcase China's ambitions and capabilities, and the message was sent very loudly for the world to hear. Although teams from the United States, Germany, Japan, and Brazil participated, the [overwhelming majority of competitors were Chinese](https://substack.com/redirect/392384d2-11dc-4e0c-8e76-17f3a337b16a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The PRC has designated humanoid robotics as a [national strategic priority](https://substack.com/redirect/45c1d448-3e9d-4588-b891-b32675c9e524?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which means they have been pouring state resources into research, development, and commercialization in much the same way it did with solar panels, electric vehicles, and 5G. Beijing isn't hosting a robot Olympics for entertainment or for social media likes. It was making a statement: Even if the United States is temporarily ahead in AI software (i.e. the brains), China holds the lead in the bodies those brains will inhabit.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b45b6993-398a-4954-b987-28e711180fd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And what happens when these physical machines are married to AI? You end up with a Nobel Prize-winning mathematician who is faster than Usain Bolt and stronger than Arnold Schwarzenegger. A machine that can outthink you, outrun you, and outlift you, and never needs to sleep, eat, take a vacation, or call in sick. The implications for the global economy, for labor markets, for military applications, and for daily life are staggering. The hundreds of billions that five American tech companies are spending on AI infrastructure this year isn't just building chatbots. It's building the brains that will eventually power the bodies that just outran the fastest human who ever lived.
So what? Why does this matter? Well, since time immemorial, there has been one truism about human societies, expressed by Auguste Comte as: "Demography is destiny." The fates of hunter-gatherer societies and great empires alike have been determined in large part by the number of young people they have to work, fight, and reproduce. Even today, many people have suggested the future of the 21st century is being written by the baby bust in the developed world and the ramifications of the one-child policy in China.
* * *
## [The Cockroach Revolution(s)](https://substack.com/redirect/c0b5bd78-2e49-49d6-86c4-85bd3060caa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[A wave of youth-led protests has been sweeping the globe, and it is unlike anything we've seen since the Arab Spring. Over the past three years, Gen Z protesters have toppled governments, stormed parliaments, and forced presidents to flee their own palaces.](https://substack.com/redirect/c0b5bd78-2e49-49d6-86c4-85bd3060caa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
But what if the fates of nations were untethered from how many babies were being born? Armies of robot workers and soldiers would make demographics largely irrelevant, and destinies would instead be written by whose humanoids were smartest, fastest, and strongest. And the corollary, of course, is perhaps countries with high fertility rates and young populations (i.e. those with perfect demographic pyramids!) may no longer be those with bright futures. Could it be that large populations of young workers are a liability for a country in today's world? After all, young ambitious individuals expect jobs and not having enough jobs risks social and political unrest. And does that mean small population but wealthy countries can compete as global economic, military, or technological superpowers?
All of this is what makes the World Humanoid Robot Games more than just a curiosity. Labor is now increasingly interchangeable with technology. And if technology is increasingly accessible to anyone with capital, does this mean the age old battle between capital and labor is over? Has capital won? And if so, what are the implications for the future of wages, wealth distribution over time, and the risk of revolution?
The World Humanoid Robot Games took place in China. But unlike the saying about Las Vegas, what happens in Beijing is unlikely to stay in Beijing.

And the corollary, of course, is perhaps countries with high fertility rates and young populations (i.e. those with perfect demographic pyramids!) may no longer be those with bright futures. Could it be that large populations of young workers are a liability for a country in today's world? After all, young ambitious individuals expect jobs and not having enough jobs risks social and political unrest. And does that mean small population but wealthy countries can compete as global economic, military, or technological superpowers? All of this is what makes the World Humanoid Robot Games more than just a curiosity. Labor is now increasingly interchangeable with technology. And if technology is increasingly accessible to anyone with capital, does this mean the age old battle between capital and labor is over? Has capital won? And if so, what are the implications for the future of wages, wealth distribution over time, and the risk of revolution? The World Humanoid Robot Games took place in China. But unlike the saying about Las Vegas, what happens in Beijing is unlikely to stay in Beijing. | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. clean_body: [ ]Abdul for US Senate [ ]Abdul for US Senate Peter, I'm going to level with you about a number that still keeps us up at night. At the very end of the primary, there were polls floating around showing us up five points, ten points, pick a number. We won by 1%. One point, after a campaign the pundits and the politicians, you know, the very serious people, said could never succeed. After more than $70 million spent against us by AIPAC and corporate interests. I told my team the next morning what that number meant to me, and I want to tell you the same thing. Any one of you could have been the person who tipped it.< It’s not a figure of speech – it’s just math. Now, here we are again. We're tied with Mike Rogers in the newest polling. Trump's handpicked candidate, a 30-year career politician with over a year of spending and tens of millions of dollars behind his name recognition. Tied. With a few weeks left, in one of the seats that decides control of the United States Senate. So, I need to ask you for something. Tomorrow, August 31, is our end-of-month fundraising deadline. It's one of the very last we'll have before Michiganders begin voting, and right now we're running short of our projections. I'm not going to dress that up. I have never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and I never will. I won the primary without a single dollar from AIPAC, and that hasn't changed and won't change in the general. I'm not calling a corporate CEO tonight to close this gap. I'm asking you, Peter. [ ]Can you make a contribution of $10 or any amount before tomorrow night's deadline, so we can keep our ads up and our organizers in the field through the toughest weeks of this race? [ ]Donate $10 ›› If today isn't the right time for you, I understand, and I'm grateful you read this far. Knock a door with us instead. Make calls. That counts all the same in a race decided by one point. Money out of politics. Money in your pocket. Medicare for All. That platform just won the most expensive Democratic Senate primary in the country's history. Now it has to win in November, and it wins the same way it won in August: one dollar, one door, one person at a time. In solidarity, Abdul

The Justice Department and FBI seized the platforms used in a China-state-sponsored hacking operation that had breached NASA, the Federal Reserve, and the US Senate, the government announced Wednesday. The takedown killed the tools; it did not touch the people who built them, which is the limit of what a domain seizure can do.

---
An arbitrator ordered The Washington Post to reinstate a columnist it fired over social-media posts about the assassination of Charlie Kirk, ruling the paper lacked cause under its union contract. The decision hands the columnist a win, hands the Post a rebuke, and reopens the question of what a news organization may fire a writer for saying.

The average donation is about $33, but a lot of folks chip in $4 or $5. I’m truly grateful for every dollar – **_[it all helps us flip this seat.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138176705/643314134/341897524?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_t1nd_jtk5953-v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWI5N2EzMy03NmE0LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MCf8ssPHJhBT_da9aZsFmN2k7GbDwnq18lcJj0E_AJA=)_**

Senate control will come down to our race, which is why National Republicans are spending over $130 million here, and why billionaire Peter Thiel just added $3.6 million more this week. They know they cannot afford to lose Ohio, and our rigged system allows their billionaire donors and dark-money groups to spend limitless sums to try and buy this seat.
So we have to fight back, together, but it takes an enormous number of $10 and $25 donations to match what they can raise from one mega donor.
So that’s where these emails come in. It may sound exaggerated, but without emails like this, we would already have lost this race.

clean_body: The Hudson Valley raised me. Now I am running to make sure radical socialists never define it. | Hey there Peter, It’s Jackie Mary Auringer, a Hudson Valley native running for Congress in New York's 18th District to raise up the place that raised me. My parents dedicated their lives to this community, my mother as a teacher and my father as a local business owner. They raised me to believe in responsibility, accountability, and pride in where you come from. Those are the values I am bringing to this race every single day. Radical socialists just swept Democratic primaries across New York and Michigan. A brand new CBS poll found that 58% of Democrats now view socialism more favorably than capitalism. And my opponent Pat Ryan is endorsed by the Working Families Party, the same party driving this socialist wave across our state. These are not Hudson Valley values. These are not American values. And I am running to make sure they never define NY-18. Once you have verified, please pass this along to a neighbor, a friend, or a family member. Every verified patriot in this district is one step closer to stopping the socialist wave and returning this seat to commonsense leadership that puts you and your family first. Thank you for your time. I look forward to earning your vote. I’ve kept this fact at the forefront of my mind since the day we launched this campaign:
**I’m one of just TWO Democratic governors running for reelection in a state Trump won.**

Now? He never wants that to happen again -- so he’s calling up his donors, doing everything he can to install his hand-picked Republican nominee in my place.

subject: Our communities deserve answers about Flock surveillance
body:
Police have used Flock surveillance to stalk former partners. We need accountability now. | |
---
Peter, **There is a strong chance you have already been photographed by a Flock camera.** Flock is a massive surveillance network which gives law enforcement the power to search where vehicles have been, when they were there, and even identify details like bumper stickers. **Now we know that power is being abused. At least 50 law enforcement employees nationwide have reportedly been put on leave, fired, arrested, or convicted for misusing Flock and similar surveillance systems.** One former police chief searched for his ex-girlfriend’s car 164 times. Another officer was tracking whether an ex-girlfriend went to an abortion clinic. These are not just isolated cases. They show what happens when law enforcement gets access to powerful surveillance tools without enough transparency or accountability. **Our communities should have a say in how we are watched, and public institutions should answer to the people they serve.** No one should have to wonder whether a police officer is secretly searching their movements through a private surveillance network. We only know about the abuses that became public. Without an investigation, there is no way to know how many improper searches have never been uncovered or reported.
**Attorneys General cannot simply wait for local police departments to police themselves. They need to investigate who is accessing these systems, how they are being used, and whether people’s rights are being violated.**
Across Pennsylvania and the country, communities are already questioning the spread of Flock cameras and demanding a greater say over surveillance in their neighborhoods. That pressure matters.
**When people organize together, we can force powerful institutions to answer to us.** We can demand transparency, accountability, and rules that put the rights of our communities ahead of unchecked surveillance.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Yes, when you defund the government, bad things happen.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3008%2E4032634%2E6R7XOq)
---
Ronald Reagan famously said, “The most terrifying words in the English language are: I’m from the government, and I’m here to help.” That line aged like his little trickle-down economics experiment. Because I actually think the most terrifying words are: “We’re in a crisis, and the government doesn’t have a plan to get us out.” That's where we are now. Trump has spent his time in office systematically dismantling the agencies designed to protect us — and the crises caused by those cuts are already stacking up. Trump and Linda McMahon are gutting the Department of Education; they've already sliced the staff nearly in half. That means fewer resources for public schools and less support for the kids who need it most. We’re already seeing historic learning loss and lagging test scores for our kids. And while they’re cutting education funding, they’re squeezing student borrowers too. They’ve killed the Saving on a Valuable Education (SAVE) plan, forcing millions of borrowers to see monthly payments jump by $500 or more. These changes will affect not only those trying to repay their loans today but also those who can afford college in the future. Trump also hollowed out food safety oversight. His funding cuts to food safety oversight created ‘the perfect storm’ that slowed the government’s response to cyclosporiasis. Trump gutted the IRS, weakening one of the few agencies powerful enough to hold wealthy tax cheats and giant corporations accountable — while working people are left paying the price. This isn't about political philosophy. It's about real people getting hurt right now. Government isn't some abstract thing in Washington. It's the food safety inspector making sure your groceries won't poison your family. It's the public school teacher helping your kid discover what they're capable of. It's the IRS agent making sure a billionaire pays up. It's the scientist tracking the next pandemic or a cure for Alzheimer's. It's the worker enforcing the rules that stop corporations from cutting corners at your expense. The thing is, when government works, most of us don't even notice. We just get to live our lives. That's the whole point. For generations, we built a government that could tackle problems too big for any one family to solve alone. Trump is tearing that apart. And then he points at the wreckage and says: "See? Government doesn't work." That's backward. The answer to a government that isn't working isn't to make it incapable of working. The answer is to make it work better — and make sure it works for working people, not billionaires. And that is what I’m fighting for. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Derek –
I'm asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. Wherever I go, I hear frustration and concern from Virginians: Costs are out of control, from health care, to housing, to child care and utility bills. Our country has been propelled into another war of choice in the Middle East. The job market is shifting beneath our feet.
And the president doesn’t seem to have a plan. He doesn’t even seem to care. And his administration is in over its head.
But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. We've got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:
🏥 It's time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.
💾 We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we've got to ensure we don't have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.
🇺🇸 We've got to stand up for America's critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.
⚡ We've got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy.
🏠 We got to address the housing crisis by encouraging rehabilitation of existing structures, speeding up permitting, and making it easier for first-time homebuyers to obtain their first mortgage.
The path forward will not be easy but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.
I'm going to campaign this year – as I always have – by getting out on the road, talking to voters face-to-face, telling them about my record, and most importantly showing them what I'll do if I get rehired.
And the next few weeks will be hugely consequential to the outcome of November’s election. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.
A donation made today is an investment in the future we’re building together – and it truly couldn’t come at a more important time for our campaign or our country.
So I’m humbly asking, if you’re in a position to donate today, will you split a donation between my campaign and Tim Kaine's to help me hit my critical end-of-month goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-warner?amount=25]

Folks might've killed to have my job.
I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:
I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative.
So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind.

clean_body: This is Michele Tafoya – I’ve got a quick story to share if you’ll indulge me for a few moments. | Hi there, I hope you are well! Folks might've killed to have my job. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary. I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem: I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative. So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that 's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who 's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I 'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I 'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. | I put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. I 'm committing my blood, sweat, and tears to take this seat back from the political class. I 'd be honored if you'd be willing to stand alongside me. Any type of donations will make a impact on our path to victory. I hope you 'll join us, but either way, God bless you! Be brave. body:
| | Friend, My Republican opponent was on the radio recently and was asked a straightforward question by a caller about special education funding. The question focused on the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, or IDEA. He was completely unfamiliar with this law — and did not even know if it was state or federal policy. He wrote it down and promised to look into it, but he read the acronym back as "IDF" and referenced "Israeli Defense Fund," which has nothing to do with education! This would be funny if it were not so scary. IDEA is vital because it guarantees a free, appropriate public education to over 7 million students with disabilities. In this moment, when the Trump administration is cutting education staff, restructuring the agency, and proposing to shift oversight away from the Department of Education, IDEA remains the core legal shield preventing a return to systemic exclusion and inadequate school support. Every parent, educator, and advocate should be terrified by this. I do not expect every candidate to know everything about education policy. But at the very least, you should be familiar with the key issues, and IDEA is key. **Especially at a time when this administration is eroding education services and funding for the students who need it most.** As a teacher, I champion legislation to make our classrooms safer and more equitable for all students. clean_body: | | Friend, My Republican opponent was on the radio recently and was asked a straightforward question by a caller about special education funding. The question focused on the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act, or IDEA. He was completely unfamiliar with this law — and did not even know if it was state or federal policy. He wrote it down and promised to look into it, but he read the acronym back as "IDF" and referenced "Israeli Defense Fund," which has nothing to do with education! This would be funny if it were not so scary. IDEA is vital because it guarantees a free, appropriate public education to over 7 million students with disabilities. In this moment, when the Trump administration is cutting education staff, restructuring the agency, and proposing to shift oversight away from the Department of Education, IDEA remains the core legal shield preventing a return to systemic exclusion and inadequate school support. Every parent, educator, and advocate should be terrified by this. I do not expect every candidate to know everything about education policy. But at the very least, you should be familiar with the key issues, and IDEA is key. Especially at a time when this administration is eroding education services and funding for the students who need it most. https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySjfz1oFXKGVRzGsRdylM7QCkcQQYhDaEX1As_Sbtw-tT9Qz-m_YIFM2S7Zp3tnrHYUeKpyFz_pHVmm_cNzYw9NCr4wqZ83pN4L

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

I want to start with two simple words.

Thank you.

Thank you for caring about children you may never meet.

Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold.

Because that is exactly what is happening.

Every day.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySklq6Cn7FJoOMIUb2FD3deCeP-IPStYv2y-VvInVjsqHWDJBPO0jWSD3eg5LDIuReM5_lJrRFZpGxtlTEQuW11AmRd8HG0rM1y

God's children are not for sale.

And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth.

When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySlsCq8HSaY09D7zdFsBUhQ29RAwt0iYnXWRuh5TLnrza9lnhctrP6k-6HgpZvkcdJPCA971tj128tVjyfIgtdUliTvWtzyeU7s

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySmSLvFZpz1g6_C7D8UtsnbXHmygwBQnzGgftVL_nIFCdk3lSwnr0u2qZbazr1zL-wZt_zTvrKScR2k2p-rei8YPi8YJgoHEA3A

This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store.

You can't buy it online.

It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say:

"No more."

Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters.

A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity.

And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see.

Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself.

A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children.

Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission.

Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySngrYSTB1nMZEUoraOJSdSksMF1TjeN0CxyNn5Q2p4Fy1CN_zzaDDLy2o1U_fQJngNjotXio1Pk6G2d-qqHPro5P7iBfpSs_1v
Protect God's Children Today

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui.

Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart.

Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed.

I couldn't forget it.

I couldn't stay silent.

I kept asking myself one question:

"What if it were my child?"

That question changed my life.

What started as a film project became a mission and a calling.

That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom.

Not for fame.
Not for awards.
But because I believed people needed to see the truth.

For years, many people said the film would never succeed.

Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up.

But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.

And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough.

That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

Our mission is simple:

To stop the sale of God's children.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySoUqc5SYaVk07Ees5RAtyoSgFAU0d3mdQVG23_lbwvOJyluPt4q5SyDY1pi1b4zAS3hqlSnAS-Y7j694HA5l9a3xiiDpGVEfP5
Protect God's Children Today

Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear.

And every day, we work to fight back.

Jesus said,

"Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14)

Every child is precious in God's eyes.

Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth.

And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySpHvnOl1-Hd6OjJJ6dyMGTWeEShpPV4eUkRPi6w8oz4ZgLLWJOHMdaseooQHDhUOZ-1tJ8T3jTEdRc4pl59g4LY0Gg2LkERQjV

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySqRDICIRDDrODyTYGxCTJxtNtYzsEIiu8ZYCVFv6PscHF4aTVOOo6vCObq2hS4nSnrloVzHTkA2lVDbWpIP11RsA36btGTf5on
Protect God's Children Today

When you make your first gift today, you help:

- Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children.

- Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation.

- Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children.

- Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis.

- Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers.

This is how change happens.

One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.

Today, that person can be you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySrM8RJGlsDSKNn2BbtmrEVAbyG-ZaFqkX-xDlF8qOI5A9Br9rL7C3XUIFTHyxkwEU6oRiof9G1x41rNDO4byHv2fcNFkRmTKZ6
Protect God's Children Today

Will you make your first gift now?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODR9AAwAAAAAAqfvUySs5UBjYo6VRW25UEX2Qz-EzJdwG2Bpkji4KxvaZtHAXUEcvElgdLAUvB1-uqHiuxpeQMDKIFd_IHLHownBeME8Tv4ZL31NJirb
Please make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can today to help protect vulnerable children from exploitation and trafficking.

Choose your shirt size and select a color.

And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most.

Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children.

Thank you for choosing action over silence.

With gratitude and prayer,

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

P.S. Your FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt is available only for a limited time and only while supplies last. Please make your first gift today, choose your size, and join a growing movement committed to protecting vulnerable children. Every child matters. Every child deserves freedom.

Fellow Patriot - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise.

**[But I need you with me, starting today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d126c1e4de374ce7a36dbe244529f481&_e=8lnkQLy58UiTDxcNw1do7VVwEBFYlIlfMKZ3Yc_HmfJVWSZ61QanYGL_SIe1JH5ln3NXF48mTNWR7X5p9NOguwh_OgrnPuJJxXp1mvUhRFEYkcEmrCiKYK-2w1GHOaw1ww3SoUFA8qa7R3RrUyoyJ74qRz6l0c-X3Ymx1MDcZEEgnjI9yQtl5vPK6j8X6zxWuqxwPtptgvD9NSbxkSAoMQqYodl8b2bHnPjDZJwg9R_3iFwoJlCrGp1qH_jtBnsy62fCUG5NJMxFfQSXAFFjELKbKz64woaHizs-bF1GWt1KMziHbOT5w0cmjWqcC_eKU1UyLCGsFtYiWKMrYlQ2BMzE8HpNfIWc5af0WDYom35P5SGrUhNjdOd7aLLpaPFNGxHMXhl-6B6HCbHnbglVkXbPhb09DhqGQsC2tnrt9VtrZoYV3ZtIgdgIdUFaQQOnvw77kntCvcPEebhRj45JB7nkPr9ykd3Z3Y9bTcYpbcjFZN6_2QPtwTPxINBQHVgQw75okncNjQOqcKS1-gWBm_qBMFRs_wqb-HRulV3jMpMVHo87aaV31g7GUsGaAELTevMyEnf5VP9ZXWX01FLm1yWvayxIkA5kzA7FO1u37-mcZ9tr_l5Fmps2sGpIsYFrqDjpW0SO_kW_J168qim-vyKbz0d7yVj3ggLWsCF13emXzDGb1oniYdDgTAVhhJfNjlMFnhdmpH0F4zPLJGGcOvq5w2kr58XHrkhHi3G2110%3D)**

We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) is implementing a new federal rule that requires states to hand over voter rolls to the federal government, and the USPS would then only deliver absentee or mail-in To resist fascism and elect real progressives who’ll fight for our communities, we must keep exercising our right to vote.
**Voting by mail is a safe and effective way to cast a ballot and has been for over a century.** It’s how Trump votes, and if it’s good enough for him, it’s good enough for the rest of us.
This attempt at disenfranchising U.S. voters violates our laws, including our Constitution. It’s yet another fascist attempt to seize and hold even more power and keep it out of the hands of the people.
It also threatens the expanded vote-by-mail protections implemented by states like mine. A few years ago, Michigan voters voted to expand our voting rights, including voting by mail.
We can’t let the federal government undo progress like this. If the courts allow this rule to stand, it could deny ballots to millions of registered voters.
[**Now after a Supreme Court decision added new chaos to the ongoing litigation, including on-again off-again injunctions and restraining orders, we’re demanding every member of Congress speak out in opposition to attacks on voting rights and our right to vote by mail.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38444h6odkaX4P2ltQr0CzRBbTNTQ5gBWJEdVxsEU9Z1Rgl9W70yF4ad32rCXlg0UCU4ec_gKU2LTJDW2pV7yq4oge9ZbrVoXwNjluoiDgy1sZDuGU-Sm3YSm56Wc7s-mruh8Bt2beO58aLUSHw1Z0YAwXAjkpn7Aubeo_bPGVSJxKgrb_-vMkbNuzkmEME4FrrOvrPMl7u9T-MlqLksbxFuRNMnhAxiOXUjwvebwbij611dMVuNyVsa3u08JwHRGAg2e9Jh3nIC1nfcFOd8GRtGMt1cXkOrYmFAwiT7X6r93khpV7XH0J3ZPM8iACOa1eJmAKbu3o-JxkDkYBVRVngXW2BhytRCxxoat5jCOBFaZvEmlh6p4eDE3o1LvpBNly8fwMRT0v-GYaL5tVUPyI6e2zkT5e89p3_NdPEg5asHsEb5vjD8s1olkMOkFTMnHA_QdpRQH-gGU92NmYql3ox9qjYHV9hVt_QSuN2LMCjjTLID0fC5ERHOyH5Refq-v1XvzGymgC7mzsyAF4zOHzb_BWP55yZHILZjd4HZxLJMxbH4BFk6jJ4UKZeDngECM_z8jim8uL414gYlat0l8HH/4tm/aPa6NbNqTsiVAmVDkGz0EA/h3/h001.PMUXgAt-4D00WDq3-3hXeCbCXc2oqXvYMVC4Npr_vYQ)

Friend,
Donald Trump is weaponizing the U.S. Postal Service in an attempt to control who can vote in our elections.
Trump’s new Postmaster General is implementing a scheme that requires Secretaries of State to hand over state voter rolls. And anyone who doesn’t appear on the Trump administration’s list of approved voters won’t be able to vote by mail.
This latest attack on our right to vote is part of the administration’s broader attacks on our democracy, including Trump’s obsession with passing the so-called _SAVE America Act_ that would disenfranchise tens of millions of voters by, among other things, requiring proof of citizenship documentation to register to vote or change your voter registration.
**States run our elections, not the federal government. And the USPS and the Trump administration have no authority to determine who is eligible to vote.**
[**Every member of Congress needs to speak out in defense of our constitutional right to vote and reaffirm each state’s authority to run its own elections.
