In the parched landscape of South Texas, Corpus Christi is hurtling toward a distinction no American city wants: it may soon become the first modern municipality in the United States to completely run out of water. Its two primary reservoirs, Lake Corpus Christi and Choke Canyon Reservoir, have plummeted to historic lows of roughly 8 to 10 percent capacity after five brutal years of drought. City officials currently estimate about a year of water remains in storage, and while recent floodwaters have pushed back the timeline for a critical Level 1 Water Emergency from late 2026 to fall 2028, the reprieve is temporary. A massive desalination plant, long touted as the region's salvation, remains stalled by funding gaps and bureaucratic gridlock, with any new supply not expected until late 2029.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/886e10df-1130-4a3e-9596-97f6ed638a62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet in the same breath that Corpus Christi warns residents about dwindling reserves and enforces Stage 3 restrictions--banning lawn watering and sending crews to drill emergency groundwater wells--the city is quietly positioning itself as an emerging strategic hub for one of the world's most water-intensive industries: **data centers**...

---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/heartlandjournal/p/the-curious-case-of-corpus-christi?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store-no-desktop&inbox=true&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

In the parched landscape of South Texas, Corpus Christi is hurtling toward a distinction no American city wants: it may soon become the first modern municipality in the United States to completely run out of water. Its two primary reservoirs, Lake Corpus Christi and Choke Canyon Reservoir, have plummeted to historic lows of roughly 8 to 10 percent capacity after five brutal years of drought. City officials currently estimate about a year of water remains in storage, and while recent floodwaters have pushed back the timeline for a critical Level 1 Water Emergency from late 2026 to fall 2028, the reprieve is temporary. A massive desalination plant, long touted as the region's salvation, remains stalled by funding gaps and bureaucratic gridlock, with any new supply not expected until late 2029.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/886e10df-1130-4a3e-9596-97f6ed638a62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet in the same breath that Corpus Christi warns residents about dwindling reserves and enforces Stage 3 restrictions--banning lawn watering and sending crews to drill emergency groundwater wells--the city is quietly positioning itself as an emerging strategic hub for one of the world's most water-intensive industries: **data centers**.
The irony is almost architectural. Corpus Christi is a city whose surface water supplies provide over 95 percent of its drinking water, and whose industrial sector, dominated by petrochemical and oil refining operations, already consumes nearly half the daily supply. Now, it is inviting in a new class of heavy water users: server farms and AI compute facilities that demand immense cooling capacity to function.
Current data center infrastructure in the region is modest but growing. Lumen Corpus Christi 1 offers a 4,800-square-foot carrier-neutral facility, while the Duos Edge AI data center provides more than 450 kilowatts of critical IT load for local artificial intelligence and cloud workloads. But those are merely the foothills compared to what is coming over the horizon.
In neighboring Nueces County, Hut 8 is building Beacon Point, a 352-megawatt hyperscale campus explicitly targeting AI workloads, with initial energization planned for early 2027. Cormint's 58-megawatt Bobcat site in Orange Grove is expected to come online in August 2026. SBA Edge has already launched a multi-tenant edge data center focused on Mexico-U.S. internet transit and distributed computing. These projects represent billions in capital investment and hundreds of permanent jobs. They also represent staggering new demand for a commodity Corpus Christi no longer possesses in abundance.
The climate signals have been blinking red for decades. Scientists and regional hydrologists have warned repeatedly that South Texas is poised for a water crisis, as rising temperatures and shifting rainfall patterns render old infrastructure assumptions obsolete. The reservoirs were engineered for a climate that no longer exists. As one environmental journalist put it, this is not a failure of prediction--the science has been consistent for decades--but a failure of alignment. The climate is changing faster than the infrastructure built to manage it.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=211480158&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjExNDgwMTU4LCJpYXQiOjE3ODg2MjIyNzgsImV4cCI6MTc5MTIxNDI3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ybeChaTVkGIRpmta8fqw3kt5sRLe8rHl3NsloPQWlRo)
Corpus Christi's predicament is compounded by political mismanagement. Former city officials and watchdogs point to a decade of bureaucratic missteps, delayed projects, and an over-reliance on selling water to industrial customers at rates that did not incentivize conservation or infrastructure reinvestment. City Manager Peter Zanoni acknowledged the depth of the problem in public comments, stating plainly, "We just have not kept up with water supply and water infrastructure like we should have. And it's decades in the making."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/af01f303-9283-4706-97bb-34085f53df00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The entry of data centers into this equation is not just an environmental story; it is a conflict between two competing models of economic survival. Corpus Christi is one of the nation's largest crude oil export hubs. Its identity is tied to energy production and heavy industry. Data centers promise to diversify that base and anchor the region in the digital economy. But diversification in this case may accelerate the very crisis threatening the city's viability. According to multiple reports, the gap between supply and demand is narrowing fast, and without emergency intervention, the city could soon face the kind of industrial water cutbacks that would rattle the regional economy.
City council members have taken note. Discussions about potential regulations for new data center developments have begun, though officials have stopped short of issuing a moratorium. The implication is clear: Corpus Christi wants the jobs and the tax base, but it cannot currently guarantee the water to sustain them. It is a city attempting to build the digital future while its most basic resource slips away.
What makes the Corpus Christi case so striking--and why climate scientists have reportedly reacted with disbelief--is the juxtaposition. This is not a remote desert outpost or a developing-world megacity. It is the eighth-largest city in Texas, a major American port, and a cornerstone of the U.S. energy sector. If Corpus Christi can run dry, the warning goes, so can Houston, Phoenix, or Los Angeles. The difference is that Corpus Christi arrived first.
The "curious case," then, is not merely a water shortage. It is the collision of a city running out of its most essential resource with an industry that consumes it voraciously, at precisely the moment when civic leaders should be conserving every drop. Corpus Christi is not rejecting the data center boom; it is courting it. Whether that gamble pays off--or whether the city becomes a cautionary tale about prioritizing growth over sustainability--will depend on whether new water arrives before the servers do.
In the meantime, the reservoirs keep falling, the drills keep turning, and the servers keep humming.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c2aaeb9a-888b-46f7-ae50-29070b28aa93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Folks,

Just after I reached out to talk to you about not being able to trust the polling lead we’ve had in this race, we got word about a brand-new poll here in North Carolina, and it’s not looking good:
Following the millions of dollars the GOP has been pouring into attack ads against me, **a brand-new poll shows Michael Whatley and I are statistically tied.** If that’s all you need to hear today, please use this link to chip in and stop them from taking the lead: **[_https:/actblue.com/donate_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1187&amount=5&t=8&akid=3049%2E124072%2EXlFdiT)**
North Carolina hasn’t sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 2008 – and Republicans want it to stay that way. They know that if we fail to flip this seat, we’ll lose our chance at taking back the U.S. Senate majority.
This new poll only confirms what we’ve known all along: this is going to be an extremely close race – and I’m going to need all the help I can get.
I’ve been a top target for national Republicans all cycle. So far, GOP super PACs are pouring nearly $100 million into this race to try and defeat me.

# SUNDAY, AUGUST 30, 2026
---
**A Note from Cole, CEO of The Flyover**

Dear Reader,

This week, _The Flyover_ crossed six million total readers.

Before anything else, thank you. A milestone like this belongs to the people who open our email every morning--that's you.

But the number isn't the point. The point is what six million of you showed up _for_ , and what you have walked away _from_.

You know what's on the other channel. Anchors telling you what to think before they've told you what happened. So-called "straight news" pages that read like opinion pages. The legacy media had one job, reporting the news, and somewhere along the way they decided their real job was converting you to their ideology.

The slant isn't an accident, and it isn't decided in front of you. It happens in rooms you'll never see. Every so often the door cracks open: last fall, a leaked memo revealed that a legacy media outlet had spliced a presidential speech into something it never was. Two top executives resigned. That's one leak from one room. The decisions that never leak? Those just become the evening news.

We run on the opposite principle: the truth survives the light. The facts arrive the way we found them. We don't bend them toward a conclusion, and we don't decide what you're allowed to make of them. That's your job.

**We report what happened, not what to think about it.**
**We keep the spin out and trust you with the facts.**
**And The Flyover stays free.**

That was the deal at reader one. It's the deal at six million. It'll be the deal at sixty million.

Because here's what I've learned this year, watching those newsrooms shrink and quietly walk away from their readers: a promise like ours doesn't get broken all at once. It erodes, one compromise at a time, when an outlet stops answering to its readers.

We keep ours by staying answerable to you.

So on the week you made us six million strong, I'm asking you to put your name behind the promise. If news that plays it straight is something you want to see thrive, this is how you feed it.

Support the news you can trust. Free, every morning.

Make a generous donation to support The Flyover.

clean_body: This week, The Flyover crossed six million total readers. | | | | | SUNDAY, AUGUST 30, 2026 A Note from Cole, CEO of The Flyover Dear Reader, This week, The Flyover crossed six million total readers. Before anything else, thank you. A milestone like this belongs to the people who open our email every morning--that's you. But the number isn't the point. The point is what six million of you showed up for , and what you have walked away from. You know what's on the other channel. Anchors telling you what to think before they've told you what happened. So-called "straight news" pages that read like opinion pages. The legacy media had one job, reporting the news, and somewhere along the way they decided their real job was converting you to their ideology. The slant isn't an accident, and it isn't decided in front of you. It happens in rooms you'll never see. Every so often the door cracks open: last fall, a leaked memo revealed that a legacy media outlet had spliced a presidential speech into something it never was. Two top executives resigned. That's one leak from one room. The decisions that never leak? Those just become the evening news. We run on the opposite principle: the truth survives the light. The facts arrive the way we found them. We don't bend them toward a conclusion, and we don't decide what you're allowed to make of them. That's your job. We report what happened, not what to think about it. We keep the spin out and trust you with the facts. And The Flyover stays free. That was the deal at reader one. It's the deal at six million. It'll be the deal at sixty million. Because here's what I've learned this year, watching those newsrooms shrink and quietly walk away from their readers: a promise like ours doesn't get broken all at once. It erodes, one compromise at a time, when an outlet stops answering to its readers. We keep ours by staying answerable to you. So on the week you made us six million strong, I'm asking you to put your name behind the promise. If news that plays it straight is something you want to see thrive, this is how you feed it. Support the news you can trust. Free, every morning. Make a generous donation to support The Flyover. Our promise: we answer to you. Help us keep it. \- Cole CEO, The Flyover | | The Flyover, LLC 1910 Thomes Ave. Cheyenne WY 82001 | ---|---

| | _With just nine days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 9, I am highlighting the need to fight unequivocally for our rights._
* * *
Dear David, If there’s one thing we’ve learned from Donald Trump’s two presidencies, it’s this: **Our rights are never as safe as we think they are. From reproductive freedom to LGBTQ+ rights, these rights were won with blood, and we must defend them tooth and nail.** **[Rights that generations before us fought for have been rolled back, challenged in court, and put back up for debate. We can’t take anything for granted, especially with Donald Trump in the White House. I’m not going to let Republicans take our rights away without a fight. If you’re ready to join me, please pitch in today:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oAG__uZV94vZhJm2m1pdqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/qWCmZTSERdXHJ1k6nU5aEHi75oJILSu83FCjw5sl6dn9AaaUxDW_A60_pE8i3g-NUHWkw9UVc85zF4-JgGBCrZJlBr0GNP-qVWQG036UdMIJs3xVUNu91itA41jP660ISFr2RD1E9INxtdBOtZWhysGLPi2KCBYfpGt3zsWSuiuNu6Liec0gCP8eY44SB7bnKTHsp67tQMNapLrLqFTyHLEVyPrtPo9ifM7t54cmKjFnH0QD4ETpDTZK7hkR3xd5IchWb1uQS7a8A2qpZAnrCQ~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oAG__uZV94vZhJm2m1pdqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/qWCmZTSERdXHJ1k6nU5aEHi75oJILSu83FCjw5sl6dn9AaaUxDW_A60_pE8i3g-NUHWkw9UVc85zF4-JgGBCrZJlBr0GNP-qVWQG036UdMIJs3xVUNu91itA41jP660ISFr2RD1E9INxtdBOtZWhysGLPi2KCBYfpGt3zsWSuiuNu6Liec0gCP8eY44SB7bnKTHsp67tQMNapLrLqFTyHLEVyPrtPo9ifM7t54cmKjFnH0QD4ETpDTZK7hkR3xd5IchWb1uQS7a8A2qpZAnrCQ~~)

Reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy are not negotiable. Donald Trump and anti-choice Republicans have no business inserting themselves into some of the most personal decisions a person can make.
**No politician should stand between a person and their doctor.** That’s why I will fight to protect the right to abortion, defend access to contraception, and oppose any attempt, state or federal, to roll back reproductive healthcare. I’ll also fight to enshrine Roe v. Wade as federal law and repeal the discriminatory Hyde Amendment so we end this debate once and for all.
But Republicans aren’t just attacking our right to make our own choices. **They’re also trying to tell us who we can and cannot be.** Everyone deserves to feel seen, heard, safe, and celebrated no matter who they are, where they live, or who they love.
A lot of politicians find their way to LGBTQ+ rights in June. They put rainbow-colored pictures on their social media profiles, march in a couple of parades, release a statement or two, and follow it up with silence for the next eleven months.
But Republicans don’t limit their efforts to take away LGBTQ+ rights to the month of June. They fight year-round, 24/7, 365, to attack our neighbors, **which is why _I_ promise to fight for the LGBTQ+ community in Congress. Not just during Pride month, every single day.**
**[Whether or not they’re printed on it, these rights are on the ballot. I’m ready to fight as hard as I can to defend them, and I think you are too. So let’s take the fight to Donald Trump, Congressional Republicans, and right-wing judges all across the country. clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just nine days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 9, I am highlighting the need to fight unequivocally for our rights. Dear David, If there’s one thing we’ve learned from Donald Trump’s two presidencies, it’s this: Our rights are never as safe as we think they are. From reproductive freedom to LGBTQ+ rights, these rights were won with blood, and we must defend them tooth and nail. ~~ | | ~~ Reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy are not negotiable. Donald Trump and anti-choice Republicans have no business inserting themselves into some of the most personal decisions a person can make. No politician should stand between a person and their doctor. That’s why I will fight to protect the right to abortion, defend access to contraception, and oppose any attempt, state or federal, to roll back reproductive healthcare. I’ll also fight to enshrine Roe v. Wade as federal law and repeal the discriminatory Hyde Amendment so we end this debate once and for all. But Republicans aren’t just attacking our right to make our own choices. They’re also trying to tell us who we can and cannot be. Everyone deserves to feel seen, heard, safe, and celebrated no matter who they are, where they live, or who they love. A lot of politicians find their way to LGBTQ+ rights in June. They put rainbow-colored pictures on their social media profiles, march in a couple of parades, release a statement or two, and follow it up with silence for the next eleven months. But Republicans don’t limit their efforts to take away LGBTQ+ rights to the month of June. They fight year-round, 24/7, 365, to attack our neighbors, which is why I promise to fight for the LGBTQ+ community in Congress. Not just during Pride month, every single day. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~ ~ | ~ | ~~ Let’s win this fight together. — Carleigh | Carleigh Beriont is running to represent New Hampshire’s First Congressional District in Congress because Granite Staters deserve a representative who shows up and listens. ~~** | | ~~ | Paid for by Carleigh Beriont for Congress Carleigh Beriont for CongressPO Box 1912Hampton, NH 03843United States "Website"•~~ "Privacy Policy"

Peter,
Wyoming's Republican Gov. Mark Gordon just called for an investigation into Trump admin election monitors.
On August 18, Wyoming held its primary election. Unannounced Department of Justice "election monitors" showed up at polling locations across the state, catching the Republican governor, attorney general, and secretary of state completely off guard.
What followed was behavior Governor Gordon described as "aggressive" and "irregular." In one incident, two DOJ attorneys showed up unannounced at a Wyoming polling site, delayed showing their credentials, attempted to "inspect" voting machines, and asked questions County Clerk Debra Lee said went way beyond their legal authority.
Now, Gov. Mark Gordon has asked his attorney general to investigate these incidents:

_**Patriot**_ , I want to tell you about the town I grew up in. Jackson, Georgia isn’t the kind of place that makes national news very often. It’s not a big city. It doesn’t have a famous skyline or a professional sports team. What it has is something a whole lot more valuable, and a whole lot harder to replace. _**It's the kind of town where July 4th is still a big deal.**_ Where folks put flags on their porches not because somebody told them to, **but because they genuinely mean it. ** Where the hardware store owner knows your daddy's name, and where people still hold the door open for strangers without thinking twice about it. Where you can still hear a crowd go quiet when Taps plays at the cemetery. Where the old veterans in the parade get the loudest applause every single time, because every single person standing on that sidewalk understands what those men and women gave up so the rest of us could be there. _That's the America I grew up in._ And I'll tell you, I never took a single day of it for granted. _**Patriot**_ , I think about that America every single day of this campaign. Because here's what I know about Jon Ossoff that I don't think gets said enough: **He doesn't represent that America. ** If he had his way, towns like Jackson would be quietly forgotten, **left behind in favor of the coastal elite's vision of what this country is supposed to look like. ** Diversity committees, government programs, and Washington bureaucrats deciding what's best for people they've never met and communities they've never set foot in. That's not a small disagreement about tax policy, **Patriot**. That is a fundamental difference in what we believe America is supposed to be. This race is about policy, yes. **Ossoff's vote to skyrocket your grocery bill. ** **His vote to send stimulus checks to prisoners and illegal aliens. ** **His votes to let men compete in women's sports. ** **_Those things matter enormously, and I am going to fight him on every single one of them._** But underneath all of that, this race is about something bigger. **It's about what kind of America our kids and grandkids grow up in.** It's about whether the town where a little boy can watch veterans march down Main Street and feel something real in his chest can still exist in twenty years. I believe we can save that America. I believe it's worth every fight, every mile on the road, every dollar raised, and every prayer said between now and November. Here in our state, I will continue fighting to protect every eligible voter’s right to vote, whether they cast their ballot in person, early, or by mail under state law. _But defending democracy doesn’t happen by itself._ It takes leaders willing to stand up when voting rights are challenged. _Like I said, I’m Joe Males. I’m a Mexican-American who was adopted by two wonderful parents when I was four years old._

**At a young age, I joined the United States Marine Corps to defend our country and ultimately earned the rank of Sergeant before my discharge.** Once I entered civilian life, I started my entrepreneurial career owning a successful small computer business until my son took over the family business.

**Since the Democrats will want to use this to attack me, I will tell you: I was a former Democrat.** I switched over to the Republican Party during the Reagan era once I saw what the Democrats truly stood for. I’ve seen firsthand how today’s Democratic Party has abandoned working families. Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California.

**WHY DID I ENTER POLITICS?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=3860446331954a3eba102be6a584190f&_e=RnmNu8f-qzdhV8PwwMNof7Kui9hPfGHJ4lG3tf_6RdSW3Cz5XzbrU2Qc18lv6u3y9TKKb8sWvPnkeVqSh1D7F5YG_25DffoPhR6moaphJ4PfgUXnFKSX7aaTTeSw4iacJbFNTB7Eegw6udGLeXQWi-IJ8lESAb9TljebFGUXJpp9SoPvUAlyEcSYYLFFlbsRriIeJLO3mYGGuPNZVU1bMUKx6o669Zst2JU2YqKUrR0pCe6AlOC_haO1qfiMaWid0eBfyqIi0E-flxvaP1Y3NH_J8DsLCF7wrNjQHlybmci7LxdvpTNskPVELR2Ok2NedxF9N5TIuQe0PQLjY0XcB-XhpBHjy7StHl5cPjrwT2SJCDEfFwg-QlM-_cIRHZN9OkLJ5GnmFCK0vTn3yADLp0Uq8w3-l2Epr7caEPzQN39g6fjAyxmgNL-Qw9MR_UaswWoaCD9eubAFrGBlzGG3a-GZe2CsbG4PV-7Ewy9-c3zxRgoj3ZleMMUb2qqZByJ4tGnfHa3rrMOW7OH67yjoSQ%3D%3D)

**In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016.**

If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened.

He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold.

**I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy.** Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him.

_**As a former Democrat turned Republican, I know what the Democrat Party is supposed to represent. But ever since the Reagan era, they’ve continued to move farther and farther to the extreme left. Now, they stand for DEI, wokeness, putting Americans last, and doing everything they can to fight against President Trump.**_

**As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration.** America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY.

**Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration.** Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security.

**On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement.** After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness.

**As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around.** Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. I’ll do everything in my power as a Congressman to support our military so we prioritize READINESS over WOKENESS.

**Finally, we must dismantle DEI in every corner of the government.** DOGE’s work to cut wasteful spending has been a great start, but we must continue to fight to lower the cost of living, defend free speech, and usher in the Golden Age of America.

**WHY DO I NEED YOUR HELP?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=3860446331954a3eba102be6a584190f&_e=RnmNu8f-qzdhV8PwwMNof7Kui9hPfGHJ4lG3tf_6RdSW3Cz5XzbrU2Qc18lv6u3y9TKKb8sWvPnkeVqSh1D7F5YG_25DffoPhR6moaphJ4PfgUXnFKSX7aaTTeSw4iacJbFNTB7Eegw6udGLeXQWi-IJ8lESAb9TljebFGUXJprzMh_yS19UWVy7rHAu5XTFcmI-eCKchXGGi3cbqfsICAEpbAmb-6xUD66Sk_uYOvHrPG2eeH9Qk3cOaxteC6CMTQ1V3WB8r2SOlmKVphdGh9Qvlj9OgwGJKPoW-TsB0s94j3TWfrtIGYPIHRezgLMM8lAR8QUgwYNq19gF1UTDWEgb7dEmParqp5Dyr1QULoEh8hBSkjUguTQScPLK4q3ENWW4VL7khllph7zobF-cNZ71zNlAO0o1jb_MV3QaUIRJC-Lp0WJRCeJY4w-m5WhvyTH-yRuEH0310GMHkadHUGbJGMX94JGvgNLe_Tb9qnDpEzBj04-dryf6260LTeYGDXThwKvlWoEzNHOnh3O5pQ%3D%3D)

**Simply put – the Radical Left has a stranglehold on California.** Just like they’re trying to flip Texas Blue, I’m trying to flip California Red. It may seem impossible, but so many Californians are sick and tired of suffering under Gavin Newsom, Nancy Pelosi, and Adam Schiff’s leadership here. I know many people who have left California just because of the politicians who want to turn our beautiful state into a Communist Utopia.

**But Newsom, Pelosi, and Schiff have MILLIONS of dollars in reserve, ready to spend against my campaign to prevent common sense leadership.** They only care about lining their own pockets, even if their constituents suffer. _It’s going to be an uphill battle, but if there’s one thing I learned as a Marine, it’s that the only way to create a better tomorrow is through dedicated hard work and grit. Together, we can fight and WIN._

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California. WHY DID I ENTER POLITICS? In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016. If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened. He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold. I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy. Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him. WHAT ARE MY PRIORITIES AS YOUR NEXT CONGRESSMAN? As a former Democrat turned Republican, I know what the Democrat Party is supposed to represent. But ever since the Reagan era, they’ve continued to move farther and farther to the extreme left. Now, they stand for DEI, wokeness, putting Americans last, and doing everything they can to fight against President Trump. As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration. America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY. Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration. Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security. On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement. After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness. As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around. Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. I’ll do everything in my power as a Congressman to support our military so we prioritize READINESS over WOKENESS. Finally, we must dismantle DEI in every corner of the government. DOGE’s work to cut wasteful spending has been a great start, but we must continue to fight to lower the cost of living, defend free speech, and usher in the Golden Age of America. WHY DO I NEED YOUR HELP? Simply put – the Radical Left has a stranglehold on California. Just like they’re trying to flip Texas Blue, I’m trying to flip California Red. It may seem impossible, but so many Californians are sick and tired of suffering under Gavin Newsom, Nancy Pelosi, and Adam Schiff’s leadership here. I know many people who have left California just because of the politicians who want to turn our beautiful state into a Communist Utopia. But Newsom, Pelosi, and Schiff have MILLIONS of dollars in reserve, ready to spend against my campaign to prevent common sense leadership. They only care about lining their own pockets, even if their constituents suffer. It’s going to be an uphill battle, but if there’s one thing I learned as a Marine, it’s that the only way to create a better tomorrow is through dedicated hard work and grit. Together, we can fight and WIN. | Thank you for taking the time to read all of this. I truly appreciate it. Semper Fidelis, Joe Males Meet Joe Males: Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission. Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved. Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same. Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy. During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met. clean_body: Will you join the No PAC Club before our end-of-month deadline?| | | | Peter, Since the Supreme Court’s Citizens United decision, billionaires and big corporations have spent over $1.5 billion trying to buy our democracy. But here’s the truth: our democracy is not for sale. That’s why I never have – and never will – take a dime from PACs or lobbyists. And that’s why I co-founded the No PAC Caucus in Congress: to build a government that answers to people, not special interests. = = This isn’t about the amount. It’s about sending a powerful message to Washington that millions of people are willing to put their money where their mouth is and demand a government that belongs to the people, not the highest bidder. = Thank you for your activism and all that you do. In solidarity,Ro | | | | | | | Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future. If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. name: Team Gina
subject: Abbott has spent $7 million on ads.
body:
Will you help us run our ads?
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Take a look at this map, Peter:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260830_3_dma.KJ6ML8&refcode=em20260830-1964&t=1&akid=1964%2E299639%2Efi5xuZ)
What if we told you this map is one of the most important things in our campaign office?
**This is a map of Texas’s media markets.** Those are the regions that define where one TV program starts and ends. It also determines which voters see our ads and which voters we can’t reach.
Because when we put an ad on the air, our team has to buy that airtime. **And we have to do it for each of Texas’s 20 media markets _over and over again._**
That’s more media markets than any other state. Simply put, it takes more time and more money to run an ad in Texas than it would in most other states.
**Abbott has already spent _$9 million on ads_ promoting his campaign during hundreds of commercial breaks in all of the biggest markets.**
That’s why we’re asking if you can help us raise the money we need to keep our ads on the air. Poll after poll shows we beat Abbott when voters hear our message. We can win this race if our ads stay on the air.
**[Will you chip in $5 or whatever feels right to you to help us run our ads in every media market in Texas?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260830_3_dma.KJ6ML8&refcode=em20260830-1964&amount=5&t=2&akid=1964%2E299639%2Efi5xuZ)**

clean_body: Just 9 days left in our primary election. | | | | = | | | PPeter, This email isn't going to everyone. It's going to a smaller group of supporters who have already stepped up and shown they believe in this campaign. In just 9 days, voters in New Hampshire will go to the polls and vote in our primary election. That means we only have 9 days left to reach every undecided voter across the district. Our TV ads are doing just that. But airtime is expensive, and in a race this competitive, we need your help to keep our ads running during this final stretch. Outside money is flooding into this race. We’re being outspent. So I have to ask: If you're able, I'm asking you personally to make your next contribution today. Even $15 or $25 helps us show strength at a moment when it truly counts. = Thank you for believing in what we are building together, Stefany | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Stefany Shaheen for Congress | | Stefany Shaheen for Congress PO Box 193 Manchester, NH 03105 United States | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. It's something to be said that the Department of Justice has had to get creative to get around California's policies that protect illegal aliens who commit crimes. You would think California would want to get these people out of the state, but that would require logic, common sense, and a willingness to put American citizens first.
In response, the Central District of California, which comprises the counties of Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Luis Obispo, Santa Barbara, and Ventura, **[launched Operation Guardian Angel.](https://substack.com/redirect/9b4b0318-8e28-4470-80bf-e5567a887503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Operation Guardian Angel apprehends criminal illegal aliens in county jails, whose cooperation is prohibited by "sanctuary state" laws from cooperating with federal immigration officials. The DOJ secures federal arrest warrants for aliens recently arrested by California law enforcement. Local jails are legally required to honor the arrest warrants and must hand over the criminal illegal alien to the federal government.
Since launching Operation Guardian Angel in May 2025, the DOJ has forced California to turn over 362 criminal illegal aliens into federal custody. A total of 769 arrest warrants have been issued.

Over half of those wanted by the federal government have been charged with illegally re-entering the United States after being removed. Other federal charges include unlawful possession of a firearm by an alien, unlawful possession of a firearm by a felon, using a firearm in drug trafficking or a crime of violence, and possession of a controlled substance with intent to distribute.
"Broken California 'sanctuary state' policies endanger the public and cannot go unchallenged by the federal government," said First Assistant United States Attorney Bill Essayli. "Operation Guardian Angel is an answer to these misguided policies. Through this task force we are forcing California to do the thing it hates most: handing hundreds of criminal illegal aliens into federal custody to face justice and deportation."

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Foundation
subject: Patriot, did you catch The Defiant Ones?
body:
Defiant Ones is finished. All eight episodes are up, and you can listen to the whole thing this weekend.
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/ib5TdIIVmg1-aWpQYLHjpmwJnOiBTm9-xPKl6XRx5fc=452)Patriot–[ _**Defiant Ones is finished.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/7MF5eLAMDQS_oZcRXczgxkbwmXUFcxovVbtnPKpeOs0=452) All eight episodes are up, and you can listen to the whole thing this weekend.In the spring of 1776, Abigail Adams wrote to her husband while he sat in Philadelphia helping to invent a country, and she asked him for one thing. Remember the ladies. That letter is where this series starts.It ends with a woman whose name nobody bothered to write down.**Here is the whole series:**
* [_**Episode 1, Abigail Adams.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fabigail-adams%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/lis-_P2sSuqLtgs12eNWDVHeYmzeRgLkp-IvCesgp-A=452)**** The letter that told the Founders to remember the ladies.
* [_**Episode 2, Prudence Wright.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fprudence-wright%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/_A98GFYJwk0ULgFDvHf9tEDPaU6KSK_JwAjgozjqSwE=452)**** The women of Pepperell, Massachusetts, and the stand at Jewett Bridge.
* [_**Episode 3, Penelope Barker.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fpenelope-barker%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/UxNE3LB3FbpWo6O5KZO192QRJAcg2VSQyJju3GGtZjA=452)**** Fifty-one women in Edenton, North Carolina, signed their names and sent them across the ocean for a king to read.
* [_**Episode 4, Phillis Wheatley.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fphillis-wheatley%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/jcHNn8v1AOhUPlIJFmHzm3adAuuRxCi5weQkWpkDttQ=452)Kidnapped from West Africa as a child, enslaved in Boston, and read by George Washington.
* [_**Episode 5, Sybil Ludington.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fsybil-ludington%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/P208vj64ePLrDI4u8-WPipVJclwdbZxRgvOOCvbeaIY=452)**** The sixteen-year-old said to have ridden through the dark the night Danbury burned.
* [_**Episode 6, Two Kettles Together.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Ftwo-kettles-together%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/Csh4iEV6vAbDr_p9PsNMYE5XN_tgh8AzqhY7Q8hnnYo=452)**** An Oneida woman who went to the field at Oriskany, in a fight that split her own people.
* [_**Episode 7, Deborah Sampson.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fdeborah-sampson%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/77_ITO3lgBhQPXebwLXoTJVw3e6l3yo77rfjBLEz9h0=452)**** She enlisted in the Continental Army as a man and served seventeen months.
* [_**Episode 8, Agent 355.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.washingtontimes.com%2Fdefiant-ones%2Fagent-355%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/28_2cJbBf4EFbyCXqe6fm4L8GBWDPocKQmsXDiqYNtY=452)**** A spy in British-occupied New York, remembered by a number instead of a name.

Some of these women were remembered by the people who knew them.Deborah Sampson served those seventeen months under the name Robert Shirtliff. Years after the war, Massachusetts granted her a soldier's pension and put the reason in writing, calling her an extraordinary instance of female heroism. Later a neighbor of hers wrote to her congressman on her behalf and said she was “much more deserving than hundreds to whom Congress have been generous.” The neighbor was Paul Revere. That letter still exists.Others came within an inch of vanishing altogether.The last episode belongs to the woman we call Agent 355. The letters that survive from General Washington's spy ring in New York number one hundred ninety-three. Exactly one of them mentions a woman, and it does not give her a name. It calls her a 355 of my acquaintance. In the ring's cipher, 355 was simply the number that stood for the word lady.One number. One sentence. One letter. That is nearly everything history kept of her.Which is precisely why a series like this needed making.Tea Party Patriots Foundation is one of the partners behind this series, alongside Beautifully Flawed Productions, The Washington Times, and The Women In My World. This was the summer America turned 250 years old, and I cannot think of a better way to have spent it than helping put these eight women back into the story where they belong.Abigail Adams asked that the ladies be remembered. This is us remembering them.In liberty,Jenny Beth Martin
Tea Party Patriots FoundationP.S. School is starting back up. If you teach, homeschool, run a co-op, or lead a youth group at your church, the series is now complete and sitting there ready to use as a unit, with the free activity pack for the children. Eight women, eight stories, and not one of them in most textbooks. [_**Request the pack and put it to work this fall.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdefiant-ones%2F/2/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/Y4AZdFGimwe1c1C2bhACdkavOiRzzxxGbNf8rqXShno=452)[ CONTRIBUTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdonate/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/otYgTI5iZ-0Ds6Q7lecRu7mnLDvUlOIoRMuLqvSwLgw=452) _This email list is a joint venture of the following separate organizations: Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc., Tea Party Patriots Foundation, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund. All rights reserved.__Tea Party Patriots Foundation is an independent 501(c)(3) non-profit organization that exists to promote the ideas of the Tea Party movement and to engage in charitable and educational activities._ To donate by mail, send your check made payable to:[_**Tea Party Patriots Foundation**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Ffoundation%2Fdonate%2F/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/9LF2RPOhBG8GbSeILpILdtNLp92UDt_1VrrDHM1wM1s=452)

Woodstock, GA 30189Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [unsubscribe](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpot.teapartypatriots.org%2Fcontact-preferences%2F01jp3rk1m05jb3jy5xyw9vqr5t%3Fct=1ebd6a5833cd%26et=a8fe34ad85d9/1/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/He7ERJYlCv9B81bsjBvk8xTINckqZFYEMbPxVsVZlfI=452) or [update your preferences](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Ftpot.teapartypatriots.org%2Fcontact-preferences%2F01jp3rk1m05jb3jy5xyw9vqr5t%3Fct=1ebd6a5833cd%26et=a8fe34ad85d9/2/010001a054978903-c24f1b3b-6220-4d58-aae2-8dd8bcbc1a71-000000/JQJe6HfxLhiHHgSrn9Gpp_YmMOJ-z1xAG76tdChRRhA=452).

clean_body: He didn't. | | | | | Hi Peter, Charlie Hatcher says he's a workhorse who shows up for Tennessee. His record tells a different story. | When Hatcher was appointed to serve on the Rural and Small District Subcommittee of the Tennessee Department of Education, he skipped every single meeting he was supposed to attend. Chaz has been in every corner of this district, listening to voters, knocking doors, and making the case that Tennessee families deserve someone who actually fights for them. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers. This is how change happens. One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.**Today, that person can be you. Will you make your first gift now? Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. | | Dear Friend, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. **Now he's fighting for his own freedom** – [**and he needs your help.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx.
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ **Support Sgt. Duran** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. [**Will you help Sgt. Duran fight for his freedom?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. **They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.** **Their own lives have been threatened because of this case.** That's why I’m asking for your help today. **[Please make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more to help fund Sgt. Duran's appeal and give him the resources he needs to fight for his freedom.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** **_Erik spent 15 years protecting others._** **_Now he needs people like you standing behind him.[Every donation makes a difference.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)_** **_Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran._** Sincerely,
---
| | | **Jason Johnson, President** _**
Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**_

clean_body: Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Friend, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison. Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. Erik spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! | | | | ---|---|---|--- © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 |

In 1990, Will Smith was twenty years old and considered washed up.
He'd had the big hit--"Parents Just Don't Understand," the Grammy, the video you can still picture. Then he spent all the money. Then he found out, apparently for the first time, that you have to pay taxes on money you spend. He owed the federal government something like half a million dollars. Jive had dropped him. No record deal, no acting career, and he had never acted in his life.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/992257c9-3efd-472d-b76e-8a94bf209b01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So when he took a sitcom, it was not a big break. In Andy Borowitz's words, it was closer to: maybe I can pay my taxes.
Andy created that show. He sat down with me for an hour and a half, and this is the part where I tell you that I have interviewed a lot of people this year and this was one of my favorite conversations of the entire run.
_**Watch that.**_ Watch it for the sweet potato pie story, which I am not going to spoil, except to say it involves a junior writer named Benny Richburg quietly telling his white boss that the Thanksgiving menu in the script was, let us say, not the menu--and what happened in the studio audience when they fixed it. Andy describes the reaction as "a nuclear weapon exploding."
And watch it for the part where the network--every executive of whom was white and rich--kept giving notes because they related to the wealthy lawyer parents instead of to Will. They wanted Will to say "just kidding" after his jokes. Andy told the president of the network: you have all been to a black tie dinner, and the audience has not. They are going to relate to the kid making fun of the room.
It was the highest-testing pilot the network had that year.
That is one story. There are ninety minutes of them.
In the full conversation, Andy also explains what Fox News actually wanted when they booked him, which was not a comedian. He says the thing nobody with a network contract will say--"I am a Democrat, I've never pretended to be both sidesy"--and makes the case that equal-opportunity satire is a lie when one side is doing all the lying. We get into the life of a comedy writer, what he learned from Carroll O'Connor that he was still using twenty years later, and why a show that made hundreds of millions of dollars was never treated inside the building the way Friends was.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3d97d80c-a99e-46f9-8afd-5b048abba011?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The whole thing is for paid subscribers. That is not me being precious about it. There is no advertiser paying for this show, no network, no corporate parent. There is a camera, a producer, an editor, and you.
Here is the pushy part, and I am going to be honest that it is the pushy part.

Andy Borowitz created it--and the best story he tells about it is about sweet potato pie. | | | Aug 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- In 1990, Will Smith was twenty years old and considered washed up. He'd had the big hit--"Parents Just Don't Understand," the Grammy, the video you can still picture. Then he spent all the money. Then he found out, apparently for the first time, that you have to pay taxes on money you spend. He owed the federal government something like half a million dollars. Jive had dropped him. No record deal, no acting career, and he had never acted in his life. | | ---|---|--- So when he took a sitcom, it was not a big break. In Andy Borowitz's words, it was closer to: maybe I can pay my taxes. Andy created that show. He sat down with me for an hour and a half, and this is the part where I tell you that I have interviewed a lot of people this year and this was one of my favorite conversations of the entire run. Watch that. Watch it for the sweet potato pie story, which I am not going to spoil, except to say it involves a junior writer named Benny Richburg quietly telling his white boss that the Thanksgiving menu in the script was, let us say, not the menu--and what happened in the studio audience when they fixed it. Andy describes the reaction as "a nuclear weapon exploding." And watch it for the part where the network--every executive of whom was white and rich--kept giving notes because they related to the wealthy lawyer parents instead of to Will. They wanted Will to say "just kidding" after his jokes. Andy told the president of the network: you have all been to a black tie dinner, and the audience has not. They are going to relate to the kid making fun of the room. It was the highest-testing pilot the network had that year. That is one story. There are ninety minutes of them. In the full conversation, Andy also explains what Fox News actually wanted when they booked him, which was not a comedian. He says the thing nobody with a network contract will say--"I am a Democrat, I've never pretended to be both sidesy"--and makes the case that equal-opportunity satire is a lie when one side is doing all the lying. We get into the life of a comedy writer, what he learned from Carroll O'Connor that he was still using twenty years later, and why a show that made hundreds of millions of dollars was never treated inside the building the way Friends was. Peter,

The Democratic Socialists Party wants to take over South Carolina.

People are moving to South Carolina in droves to get _**AWAY**_ from the blue state policies of the Democratic Socialists. We cannot - and must not - allow Democratic Socialists to gain a foothold in a conservative state like South Carolina.

We had a great victory, but it is not the finish line. In fact, it is the starting line for an even bigger fight that lies ahead.

**Liberals believe that if they could defeat conservatives in South Carolina, then they can defeat us anywhere. Once again, they are coming for us and the South Carolina values we hold dear.**

**[Will you chip in $5, $10, $25, or even $100 to help us stop the Democrat takeover?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=812dc02208f149059204e5707f8f6296&_e=uJuEGYt0Kbv7c-e-54UmnNEg0I7l-TAmn68QK0q2Kxa6t2eD7X-m-woB5c8VmY79sy-fByX5Yd0LTGd2ZoyCkt95HpFyRKTYW_F5SuWpJnV-mCw8SpLSHkdj28EJ_CXhzeJMPXZKtop5E8Pa_0SZpIzfNI-7MMC2ZdxvFalxFVX7zGyNlg5o69_aLDiWUwi5F3sgu88fKSEIXPxzf9GmuZ5BDihUPQ9WaX-eXDVqy2eYkzmcHDiOSe2VwMunhUWrd4TMZgGNf2VI3cSn9igC1RfuU5y1EPVFiVW1Hcb5vwEcCpXGgej__O02hO8-r2kXwDMQKTUF-yi1s_ATnyaamKSTBhO0c_CXsVMgVWQXAXZqvbytps3Vr3zTxXqiewmGPc9ZoveITqAGjMV_s--nFoScwrieOSLlpjpt1HWdE1nJBT9ay4KTpt1pSYtEetVNDqTLoqJt5EHyEwZlRBjMQBBrr56t29vDMmNWhar9i5sb0Vf1XtK2lSxE7yw77KdzWDp6RwndHT44Ek5QqFPi2TRga_SYRaXq4MN4hxYq7L6KDoHF4QbP9rhEtrq3mwxs6LWnPMPNM-IkvVrOktFGG2e04TuoTuRv0MQjv_-3Sk12IO_k_s6xrSLD2OKflfdlQTksRpWSdLYU7yW1F1w5vBTpzOt8sMDM9H7hy3TrchjK9E1SW1Gj_oAz01LF-XePVmYG--4vEy9t9qhFYdzuyqRnO_9tb9vUxDX5nISrt_UW1yHx5Q-Xmr8g9mxBlF5pH3kErGxrx3peCTtINeB0Jw%3D%3D)**

For those who are not aware, you need to know that my Democrat opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, is the most radical liberal ever nominated for a statewide office by the South Carolina Democrat Party.

She won't disavow their most liberal policies. Her views are those of Bernie Sanders and AOC.
* If you LIKED Kamala Harris for President, you are going to LOVE Dr. Annie Andrews.
* No person in South Carolina has pushed harder for the absolutely terrible idea of turning confused little boys into little girls and vice versa than Annie Andrews.
* Gun control. Government-run health care. Abortion until the moment of birth. Bad idea after bad idea. Annie Andrews backs THEM ALL.

I have a different background and vision for our state.

I am a hard worker with a servant's heart. I grew up in the back of a bar and liquor store, in one room in Central.

For the past 30 years, I've worked hard for the people of South Carolina, and for the past seven years, I've led a state agency.

And I understand the struggles facing South Carolina families because I have faced them too. As your senator, I will continue to work to grow our economy and put South Carolina families first.

**[But I cannot do it without your help.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=812dc02208f149059204e5707f8f6296&_e=uJuEGYt0Kbv7c-e-54UmnNEg0I7l-TAmn68QK0q2Kxa6t2eD7X-m-woB5c8VmY79sy-fByX5Yd0LTGd2ZoyCkt95HpFyRKTYW_F5SuWpJnV-mCw8SpLSHkdj28EJ_CXhzeJMPXZKtop5E8Pa_0SZpIzfNI-7MMC2ZdxvFalxFVX7zGyNlg5o69_aLDiWUwi5F3sgu88fKSEIXPxzf9GmuZ5BDihUPQ9WaX-eXDVqy2eYkzmcHDiOSe2VwMunhUWrd4TMZgGNf2VI3cSn9igC1T431ANniXc6-z_5JYmGozwQbzxTQGTqzrhAjyGnXdx5LJlW2FySZHkkgMtromBytvwJxXCURcxzznmG-FGxU3DOXW9sNJV9n2SMScVwRDD8n7plwwh4CRbuUgE0qCcMq6kCeJ4ABFW_EHmW_wwdiM774UwkUQNJ1EXSimUuQumrAdfCmvzFL5lUG8DK2AsLUfmi7yqhrEcrS4B5A36VULQ1XSUWiqx3JlNs9563ry5sFBsU38bTTI0KjD7jfZhy1RtGZPc2dKQM9r9RZmDv2LmGrykwKExwK5FUiRt4k7-0954uN95mhLhXUyV_Ib97OVT8Azmzhkm5y_Wy-AEySF0nU8uzIYDrlttexYUPKx6ApX-SLAmFXhZWBKxwd2USNQa69l2O0VCAfSgMY_PMBt9WIuyrh6V08dL5OPIqidfdzJJm_8rmXJRonTkQxw-8Z84Ee_1nwl3T9cEx-HFBgCmrb99V9k6o1qehpDVc2yaKDwWFS0F9Mvp8lUQTtxnL6g%3D%3D)**

**MEMO:** August Deadline **** **_NY-17 is one of only three districts nationwide that split their ticket in 2024 for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress._** Mike Lawler is beatable. This is a winnable district. But we are in the fight of our lives. Mike Lawler has already massively outspent us on TV ads, and he and his MAGA allies show no sign of letting up. They’re spending so much money because they are afraid. Mike Lawler has beaten two politicians before. But he’s never beaten a patriot like Cait. **_About Cait:_** Cait Conley is a proud fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a blue collar family. After graduating from West Point, she spent 16 years as an active duty Army officer, deploying six times overseas to keep America safe. She’s spent her entire career protecting Americans and taking on tough fights. She has what it takes to beat Lawler and flip this district. **_Tomorrow's deadline:_** Tomorrow is our next big monthly fundraising deadline. How much we raise over the next 48 hours will directly impact our operations for the next month. New York is the single most expensive place to run a political campaign – so we have to go over every decision with a fine tooth comb and see how we can stretch our dollars. It’s critical that we have the resources to push back on the GOP’s attacks and run a robust voter outreach operation. **_Where you come in:_** Our campaign isn’t like Lawler’s — we’re powered by everyday people chipping in what they can afford, when they can afford it. **The bottom line: The only way we’ll be able to raise the funds to run a competitive campaign is with your help.**
