Democratic nominee for U.S. House Kristi Burke (TN-01) announced the launch of her **" Walk the Walk" District Tour** today, embarking on a 64-day push across all 12 counties in Tennessee's 1st Congressional District.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ede969c-2801-4a08-a1b2-9a9a834faedf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The campaign tour centers on **direct voter contact** and **door-to-door canvassing** to build grassroots power leading up to Election Day, when Burke will face incumbent Rep. Diana Harshbarger.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly92b3Rla3Jpc3RpYnVya2Uuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoyMTM0NjIyMDMsInMiOjkwNDE2NDYsImYiOnRydWUsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3ODgxMzA1ODIsImV4cCI6MjEwMzcwNjU4MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0._UB1FTtWU1GRBoNNYAiYpYUCwrDdQaUYYUTJm_XmIxM?)
The tour kicks off on **Tuesday, Sept. 1** , with a [Canvassing Rally in Washington County](https://substack.com/redirect/9e597be2-15df-4ea5-85d4-44b3af3a9b0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The event begins at 5:30 p.m. at Civitan Park (Pavilion 1, 1000 N. Broadway St., Johnson City, TN). Volunteers will receive quick training, access to the canvassing app, and campaign materials before heading out into local neighborhoods to knock on doors.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9e597be2-15df-4ea5-85d4-44b3af3a9b0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Sign Up for This Event on Mobilize](https://substack.com/redirect/9e597be2-15df-4ea5-85d4-44b3af3a9b0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"So many people in Tennessee's 1st District have been completely ignored and shut out by our current representative since she took office in 2020," Burke said. "It is a huge priority of mine to make sure that none of our neighbors feel forgotten."
Over the last six months, Burke's campaign has grown through community-led organizing. Campaign staff emphasize that direct **door-knocking is the single most effective way to turn out voters** and ensure working families know they have choices on the ballot this fall.
The tour kickoff is open to all community members regardless of prior campaign experience. Volunteers can pair up with experienced canvassers, and the campaign provides all necessary tools and resources on-site.
"We are so excited to get this tour kicked off and to visit all 12 counties," Burke said. "We're excited to get out the vote before November 3, and we look forward to meeting many of our neighbors along the way."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5c03095f-973f-44af-800a-112a24cd52cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Following the Washington County kickoff, the tour will host organized canvassing efforts in Sevier, Cocke, Johnson, Carter, Hamblen, Greene, Unicoi, Hawkins, Sullivan, and Hancock counties. **Locations and times for other stops on the tour will be announced soon.**
Supporters do not need to wait for the tour to reach their town to get involved; sign-ups to canvass immediately are open online.
Members of the public and press can view the full schedule and volunteer at [www.votekristiburke.com](https://substack.com/redirect/2fae1738-f9af-4eba-b78b-38a0878aab08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or by following @VoteKristiBurke on social media.
### About Kristi Burke
Kristi Burke is a community activist, muralist, and Democratic candidate running for U.S. Congress in Tennessee's 1st Congressional District. Her campaign focuses on working-class advocacy, universal healthcare, fully funded public education, and restoring transparent public representation to East Tennessee.
**Media Contact:** Dustin Street, Communications Director (dustin@votekristiburke.com)

Ten years ago, I could never have imagined where I would be today.

Serving my second term as President of the United States of America. Leading a movement whose sole goal is to make our nation the Greatest in the world.

In 2016, you placed your faith in me, and through it all, you have never wavered.

**_Never broken._**

**_Never surrendered._**

Even when it would have been easy to.

That’s why it is my greatest honor, every day, to be your President. I will never forget the trust you have bestowed upon me.

So today, I’m reaching out to you to make a promise, a solemn vow to the supporters that have been with me since the beginning.

Right now, as you read this, the Radical Left is working overtime to dismantle the movement that we have built together, destroy our great country, and halt the Golden Age we began just two years ago.

They will stop at nothing to destroy what we have built. We cannot let them.

I promise to YOU, the American People, hand over heart:
**_That I will NEVER surrender. I will never give up, and I will never stop fighting to Make America Great Again._**

We have fought every single day to create an America that our children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren can be proud of, and defeat now is not an option.

[](https://link.email.donaldjtrump._Q/sbvf0edf4ab)
That’s why today, I’m hoping I can count on your support, one final time.

Everything we have accomplished in the last two years will be swept away overnight.

We CANNOT let that happen.

Please, if you are financially able, can I count on your support for just $20.26? Your contribution today could be the deciding factor in determining MAGA’s future.

I’m asking you today with a humble heart, please keep your faith in me.

If you did spot a registration you had questions about, what's your process — can you hold it or remove it yourself, or does that have to go through the state?

Last thing — do you know what software system our DMV uses, or who at the state I'd ask about how the registration handoff works on their end?"
